ImageDescription.value: The Japanese anthem en:Kimigayo being performed in 1930. The author is unknown and the source of the record is my personal collection. The record plate is number K1-A from Polyfar Recording. (Note, some editing has been done by the uploader to reduce noise, crackling and to fix the bitrate of the recording).
